warningText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
warningText.TextScaled = true
warningText.ZIndex = 50
warningText.Parent = screenGui

task.spawn(function()
	while warningText and warningText.Parent do

			warningText.Rotation = math.random(-15, 15)

end)
